narrative.northStar: Many at Once, One at a Time
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Many at Once, One at a Time"**, namp's own. The site is namp's look on a public page, close kin to the app even where it is a docs site: the same tokens, faces, shell and signs, so a visitor who installs namp finds the page they were shown. Its values live in `src/app.css`, the faces in `src/fonts.css`, and a component's own rules in its `<style>`. This file says how to use them, its frontmatter carrying `app.css`'s tokens by their roles, which `tests/components/design.test.js` keeps equal. namp's DESIGN.md, in the namp repository, is the source this one follows: a role or a rule the site takes from the app keeps its name and value there.

namp gives a person running many agent sessions the sense of working on one thing at a time. The site does the same for its visitor: one thing in front of them at a time, the app shown at work rather than claimed, and the next action plain. What matters lifts from the ground; everything else lies flat on it.

Quiet and exact: nothing decorates, and every edge, sign and tint says something. The density is carried by type, not by boxes: headings, labels and buttons in Fira Sans Condensed, the text in Fira Sans. Colour is spent only where it says something: the one accent for focus, links and the primary action, the hues of namp's signs where the app's signs show, and what waits for the reader.
keyCharacteristics: A graphite shell, a step deeper than the ground, in both palettes: the docs' sidebar, as namp's.
The page on a plain ground, its parts separated by space, then hairlines, then a tint.
What needs the reader lifted: a fade, a shadow and a flag band, as namp's Needs you; the rest flat.
One accent, and namp's state hues each with its own sign, used as the app uses them.
The condensed cut for headings, labels, buttons and the shell.
Small corners on controls, none on rows and places.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Read a token by its role, never a value. A new role goes into `src/app.css` with a comment, in both palettes and in the system-light block, then into this frontmatter, then is read. A role namp has keeps namp's name and value.

rules.name: The Two Palettes Rule
rules.body: Dark, the default, and Light, a soft palette of a cool grey ground, white strips lifting from it and accents at a lower chroma. `<html data-theme>` picks one, set by `app.html`'s head script before the first paint from the choice kept in the browser or else the system's setting; a visitor with no script follows the system's setting through `prefers-color-scheme`, the same values. What differs by theme, an icon or a screenshot, is drawn for both and shown by the theme, never swapped once the page loads.

rules.name: The Shell Rule
rules.body: The shell is graphite in both palettes, a step deeper than the ground, in `--bay-*`. Inside `.shell` the ground's roles read as the shell's, so a link, a ring or a control drawn there takes the shell's colours without knowing it is there. The open page in the shell's list is light, `--bay-on`.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: Text is `--ink`, then `--ink-2` and `--muted`, each at 4.5:1 on every ground. `--faint` is for marks only, at 3:1: a sign, a stroke, a dot, a separator.

rules.name: The Signs Rule
rules.body: Where the site shows namp's signs, they keep namp's hue and shape: `--ok` and a check for done, `--ask` and a `?` for what waits, `--alert` and a warning sign for blocked, a turning arc in the accent for working. Words in a hue take its `-ink` token, never the mark's colour.

rules.name: The Self-Hosted Rule
rules.body: The faces are `src/fonts.css`'s `@font-face`, served from `static/fonts` with their licence, each a start face subset to what the pages write and a rest face fetched only for a character the start face lacks. `app.html` preloads the start faces the first screen paints in. Nothing loads from another host.

rules.name: The No Uppercase Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no tracked small caps. Weights 400, 500 and 600. Times, versions and counts take tabular figures.

rules.name: The One Grid Rule
rules.body: Every block of a page starts on the same left edge and its columns share the same lines: a heading, its text, a row of points and a call line up, or they differ by a step of the grid on purpose. The front page's grid is 12 columns between the gutters, `--sp-6` apart (`--sp-4` on a phone): on the first screen what namp is and the call in columns 1 to 5, and from column 6 namp's Overview, dimmed and running off the page's right edge, with Needs you lit in it; on the second the why, the gains and the call in columns 1 to 5, and the whole Overview from column 6; for a tester, after them, the two steps in columns 1 to 5 under a heading across the grid, and what to know from column 6. Each screen is the window's height at least, its blocks centred in it; content taller than the window keeps its natural height. Under 64rem every block takes the whole width and the second screen keeps its natural height, and the first view stacks under 72rem, where Needs you would squeeze its choices.

rules.name: The Steps Rule
rules.body: Space in 4px steps, `--sp-1` to `--sp-12`, and `--gutter` for the page's margin.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: What needs the reader lifts from the ground, as in namp: a strip on `--ask-fill`, fading from `--ask-wash` at its left to the strip by mid-row, with `--shadow-lift` and a flag band, `--flag` wide, in `--ask`; a reply waiting for reading lifts the same way in the accent, from `--accent-soft`. Everything else lies on the ground. Nothing else casts a shadow.

rules.name: The No Card In Card Rule
rules.body: Separate with whitespace first, then a hairline (`--line`), then a tint (`--hover`, `--sunken`). A row has no box and no radius; a surface sits on the ground, never inside another.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: One primary button per place, in the accent. Every other control is the default strip or a link.

rules.name: The Focus Rule
rules.body: One ring, `:focus-visible` in the accent. Never `outline: none` without a look in its place.

dos: **Do** read a token by its role, and add a new role to `src/app.css` in both palettes, and here, before reading it.
**Do** show namp at work, its real screens and signs, rather than describe it.
**Do** keep each page's blocks on one grid.
**Do** separate with whitespace first, then a hairline, then a tint.
**Do** keep the primary button to once per place.
**Do** let every sign that moves stand still under reduced motion.
**Do** set the theme before the first paint, and draw what differs by theme for both.
donts: **Don't** use black: text is `ink`, then `ink-2` and `muted`, and `faint` is for marks only.
**Don't** put a card in a card, or a box round a row.
**Don't** cast a shadow for anything that neither lifts nor floats.
**Don't** load a font, a script or an asset from another host.
**Don't** invent customers, testimonials, numbers or claims.
